response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is the lifecycle state of a booking, shown by the check `b.status === "pending" || b.status === "paid"` in src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts (BookingRepository, node 2e3c5728fffb0180). B is the booking itself, the thing BookingService creates in `async create(input: NewBooking): Promise<Booking>` in src/business/bookingService.ts (node 3aa201f0edaa9fd6). The status is a field of a booking, not another name for it. They are closely related, but one is a part of the other, so they don't model the same real-world thing.
